prompts.zombieWalk: Use case: illustration-story. Production 2D game animation sprite sheet, TRUE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND. Use the attached sheet ONLY for the zombie clown's design, NOT its flawed repeated walking poses. Create exactly EIGHT full-body consecutive WALK animation drawings in a strict 4-column by 2-row grid with equal generous gutters. ALL face LEFT, strict consistent side/three-quarter camera. Same green-faced, orange curly haired friendly spooky clown, patched burnt-orange and plum outfit, floppy orange cap with purple patch and gold bell, cream neck ruff, TWO separate purple shoes. Classic 1930s rubber-hose cartoon + hand-painted anime game finish, crisp black contour and subtle painted shading. A complete eight-pose walk: near leg left contact, down, passing with far leg lifted, up; then FAR leg left contact, down, near leg passing, up. Preserve the SAME near leg in front of the far leg throughout; far leg a little darker. The walk includes visible forward/back chest rocking, reaching arms alternately swaying, shoulder motion, head nod, floppy hat trailing. Eight genuinely distinct whole-body drawings; no duplicated torso pasted above changing shoes. Both feet on one common baseline in all drawings, identical character scale and head size, modest body bounce 3 percent. Fixed pelvis center per cell; no camera rotation or per-pose zoom. Cute comically drowsy zombie, no gore. No labels, grid lines, ground, backdrop, glow, checkerboard or shadows outside the figure. Very clean true alpha edges.
prompts.crawler: Use case: illustration-story. Game animation sprite sheet on TRUE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND. Reference attached zombie clown is character identity only. No text, checkerboard, scenery, floor or cast shadows.
prompts.skeleton: Use case: illustration-story. A painted modular animation kit for ONE charming vintage Halloween cartoon skeleton for a side-scrolling anime-cartoon game. TRUE transparent background. EXACT 4 columns x 3 rows, twelve separate isolated pieces, one centered in each equal cell with generous empty margin. Consistent three-quarter LEFT-facing design, warm ivory bones, broad dark ink contours, faint lavender shadow, charming rubber-hose cartoon styling, no gore or realism. Pieces in exact reading order: 0 a whole cheerful round skull with big black pie-cut eyes and tiny orange clown nose; 1 SAME skull surprised with open mouth; 2 one compact rounded ribcage with short spine, no neck/skull/arms; 3 one small pelvis, no legs; 4 one upper arm bone, vertical with round joints; 5 one forearm plus attached cartoon white mitten hand, vertical; 6 one thigh bone, vertical; 7 one shin bone, vertical; 8 one big dark plum cartoon shoe pointing LEFT, no attached leg; 9 one loose curved ivory rib shaped like a small boomerang; 10 one loose straight ivory bone with rounded cartoon ends; 11 SAME cheerful skull shown tilted on its side. These are clean cutout components to be articulated; no strings, pins, connectors, diagram lines, silhouettes behind them, captions or numbers. Maintain consistent bone thickness, drawable soft round joints, color/shading. The skull has expressive friendly spooky cartoon eyes. High-quality painted game sprites, not flat SVG/vector icons.
prompts.hexyFear: Use case: illustration-story. prompts.graves: Use case: illustration-story. Production layered cemetery game prop atlas, TRUE TRANSPARENT background, EXACT equal 4 columns by 3 rows grid. Vintage spooky cartoon painted stone with moss, rich muted purple/gray, thick dark irregular outlines; polished hand-painted game artwork, not SVG. No creatures. Row 1: four STATES of the SAME small wide grave: closed mound with crooked rounded headstone, same grave cracking softly violet through seams, same grave open with a DEEP SOLID BLACK oval earth hole behind its front dirt lip, same grave broken into stones. Row 2: four STATES of the SAME large ornate squat stone crypt: closed double stone doors, seams glowing violet before opening, doors wide open framing a SOLID BLACK interior, broken rubble remains. The crypt silhouette is twice as wide as the small headstone, cartoon gargoyle finials and small carved star, no text. All states in each row share the EXACT same size, perspective, position, bottom baseline, door/hole center and unmoving frame. Draw true dark interiors, never transparent doors or hole. Row 3: components in cells: (0) ONLY the irregular front earth lip from row1 with ragged moss and stones, seen in same perspective; (1) ONLY the front low stone step from row2, matching its width and paint, no door background; (2) detached painted cracked headstone fragment; (3) small heap of rubble. Each piece fully within its equal cell and separated by generous transparent gutter. Nothing from one cell overlaps another. No ground rectangles, no colored background, no checkerboard, no labels. The foreground lips are separate occlusion pieces so an animated character can rise BEHIND the lip and in FRONT of the black interior.
